effects.note: SRD 5.2.1: on a failed Wisdom save the target has the Charmed condition for up to 8 hours and pursues a suggested course of action (25 words or fewer), ending early if the caster or an ally damages it. v1 has the Charmed condition now but cannot drive a creature's turns toward a free-text course of action, so the narrator plays the suggestion; the charm's no-attacking-the-caster and the end-on-damage are not enforced in fights (RUN_LOG question 1)

spells.english_description: Level 2. Its effect is told by the narrator, wis save to avoid it. Requires concentration. (v1 ships a bounded version of this spell.)
